We can divide the commands into 2 categories: Getters and Setters.

https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/?group=string

Lets look at set:

SET key value [expires at] [if] [get]

// We only get the status
SET color red

[NX | XX | IFEQ ifeq-value | IFNE ifne-value | IFDEQ ifdeq-digest | IFDNE ifdne-digest]

we will talk about NX | XX

// XX - the command will only run if key already exists.
SET name mubs XX // - returns null

// NX - the command will only run if key does NOT already exists.
SET school seneca NX // - returns Ok

SET game cricket NX GET// - returns null as not prev value exist

// run it twice - u will get cricket as prev value was cricket

[EX seconds | PX milliseconds | EXAT unix-time-seconds | PXAT unix-time-milliseconds | KEEPTTL]

Now we will talk about expirey

// wait for 2 sec, it will be removed
GET hasan //  returns null
